$schema_note: TeamBuilder compatibility matrix. Read by scripts/lib/compat-check.js, scripts/doctor.*, scripts/update.*. Update this file when testing TeamBuilder against a new BMAD version. JSON (not YAML) for zero-dependency parsing in vanilla Node.

tested.notes: Tested with TeamBuilder v3.0 (initial release) and v3.1 (compat guardrails). Phase 1-5 full gate suite + Phase 6a 7-test compat-check/doctor/update suite all pass.

remediation.blocked_version: BMAD version is in the blocked list. Either downgrade BMAD or wait for a TeamBuilder release that supports it. See https://github.com/dexusno/teambuilder/issues for status.
remediation.out_of_range: BMAD version is outside the supported range. The installed BMAD has not been tested against this TeamBuilder release. Use scripts/doctor.* for details and consider downgrading BMAD to a tested version.
remediation.untested_in_range: BMAD version is in the supported range but has not been explicitly tested. TeamBuilder is likely to work but no guarantees.
remediation.missing_file: A required file is missing. The BMAD or TeamBuilder install is incomplete. Run scripts/doctor.* for details, or reinstall by removing _bmad/teambuilder/ and rerunning scripts/install.*.
remediation.schema_drift: A manifest CSV has unexpected columns. BMAD may have changed its schema in a way TeamBuilder does not yet support. Report at https://github.com/dexusno/teambuilder/issues.
remediation.agent_count_mismatch: TeamBuilder agent count does not match expected. Either an agent failed to install or the local module has been modified. Reinstall TeamBuilder if you did not modify it.
remediation.skill_count_mismatch: TeamBuilder skill count does not match expected. Either a skill failed to install or the local module has been modified. Reinstall TeamBuilder if you did not modify it.
